goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, navigate to the calendar view, and select a specific date in January 2026 to view associated memos.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in, click the 'June 2026' button in the calendar widget to open the full year view.
In the year view, locate the 'JAN' calendar grid and click on the date '1' to select January 1, 2026.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the signup page to the main dashboard after clicking 'Sign up'.
The calendar view expands to show all months of 2026 after clicking 'June 2026'.
The main content area updates to display the list of memos specifically for January 1, 2026.
The calendar widget in the sidebar updates to show 'January 2026' with the 1st highlighted.
No error messages are displayed during the account creation or date selection process.
